thread:
Mia Chen: Hey team — quick thread to align on the product launch blog draft, audience segments, and webinar/demo timing. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/content/pull/456 :eyes:
Sam Ortiz: Skimmed the PR. Structure looks good. Can we gate the detailed benchmarks behind a registration form? Keeps lead quality up.
Rachel Gupta: Gating is fine. If we gate, route leads to SFDC campaign "PL-LAUNCH-2026" and add a nurture flow. I'll sync with Growth Ops.
Omar Li: For the hero stat, use 3x throughput at 25% lower cost vs baseline — sourced from internal bench test 2026-02. Need an approval note on the methodology.
DesignBot: Mockup uploaded — https://figma.com/file/xyz. Hero variants A/B: image vs data-visual. Both sizes ready. :art:
Anya (Legal): Quick check — can we use "3x" claim? Need the benchmark doc attached or "based on internal testing" language. Send me the methodology link.
Hank (Webinar Ops): Preferred webinar window: Tue or Wed 10-11am PT or 2-3pm PT (better for EU). If publish on Mon, hold webinar Thurs so we have 3-day registration window.
Mia Chen: Proposal: Publish blog Mon May 3 10am PT, gated benchmark, demo webinar Thu May 6 11am PT. CTA flow: gated download -> calendar invite + demo opt-in -> SDR follow-up in 24h.
Sam Ortiz: +1. Also propose two headline variants for testing: "Reduce LLM inference cost by 25% without latency regressions" and "Predictable LLM inference: faster, cheaper serving". A/B in email and social.
Rachel Gupta: Add UTMs: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=prod_launch_may2026. Also set campaign UTM for the gated download link.
Omar Li: For methodology link: https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/prod-launch-2026 — Anya will that suffice?
Anya (Legal): Yes that helps. Suggest tweak: "based on our internal benchmark run; results may vary" as boilerplate.
Hank (Webinar Ops): We'll build the registration form with a question "Would you like a custom demo?" and route those to the demo queue. Also need an internal calendar + Zoom prod link.
Mia Chen: OK I'll update the PR with gated asset, UTMs, hero stat attribution, and the proposed publish + webinar times. Can folks approve copy/hero by EOD tomorrow? :calendar:
Sam Ortiz: Approved for gating and webinar cadence. :thumbsup:
Rachel Gupta: Approved the routing and UTMs. Will follow up with Growth Ops workflow.
Omar Li: Approved hero stat with methodology link attached.
Anya (Legal): Approved wording tweak.
Hank (Webinar Ops): Confirmed webinar slot reserved. I'll post the calendar invite once PR merges.
Mia Chen: Thanks everyone — updating PR and scheduling a final 15-min review if needed. Ping me in thread for any last edits. :rocket:
